title: Coleus Dazzler - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Rare Coleus
description:
Bring a burst of tropical colour to your garden or home with Coleus Dazzler!
KEY FEATURES
• Intense, vibrant multi-coloured foliage
• Ideal for beds, containers, or as a houseplant
• Adds a tropical touch to any setting
• Easy to grow and maintain
• Provides colour from summer through winter (indoors)
PLANT DETAILS
Type: Houseplants — Solenostemon scutellarioides
Colour: Green, crimson, brown, pink, white foliage
Season: Foliage interest all year (indoors), summer (outdoors)
Growth Habit: Shrubby
GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Bright, moderate sunshine or partial shade
Soil: Moist but well-drained soil, rich in organic matter
Watering: Regular watering, keep soil moist but not waterlogged. Water when top inch of soil is dry for outdoor plants, or top third for houseplants.
Spacing: Approx. 30 cm apart
Height: Up to 50 cm
Spread: Up to 35 cm
Hardiness: USDA Zone 10-11 (Tender perennial, often grown as an annual in the UK)
CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Plant in moist, well-drained soil; improve drainage with compost if necessary.
• Pinch out the growing tip to encourage a bushier plant.
• Feed container plants every six weeks; houseplants every two weeks during growing season with high nitrogen fertiliser.
• Protect from frost; bring indoors when temperatures drop below 10°C.
• Water regularly, especially in hot weather or when grown in containers.
WHAT'S INCLUDED
2x Mini Plug Plants
DISPATCH
Plants are carefully packed and dispatched Monday-Wednesday to avoid weekend delays.
